states.description: Rings stowed and locked forward, rotors still, coils at zero, petals shut.
Locks release; L4 runs aft on the rails to its operating station; service lines pay out; locks engage; dynamo rotors spin up.
Metrology scans the loops; carriages trim position and tilt from the as-stowed error to the fine tolerance; the AI checks clearances, locks and the predicted field.
Dynamos pump the coils to the stop field (31-307 h at 1-0.1 V), persistent switches close, rotors stop; the lattice is heated through activation to its operating point.
Low-power test pulses; trim coils adjust the topology; the AI compares the predicted and measured plume and converges.
The bootstrap flywheel feeds the first driver pulses; the burn starts; exhaust appears.
All locks and the alignment in tolerance, calibration residual below the threshold: lock indicators close round each engine, then across the four.
Pulse rate and flux shares follow the throttle; trim coils steer; only the plume, the diagnostics and the four-engine balance change.
Pulses stop; coils stay persistent or ramp down by the dynamos run backwards; after cool-down the rings stow. A fault ends in its own trip.

open: capture and detachment (the plume response to the field)
